mentions.name: harness-experiment
mentions.description: An experiment in coding harness self-improvement: an inner LLM (raw LLM request) paired with a harness solves coding tasks, while an outer agent such as Claude or Codex proposes changes to the harness. The infrastructure around the self-improvement loop is being improved to increase signal-to-noise ratio per experiment and generalized beyond terminal bench tasks to collect data across models, comparing harness-bound vs model-bound performance.
mentions.problem: The author realized the self-improvement everyone talks about is fundamentally an experiment design problem, and is improving the loop's infrastructure to increase signal-to-noise ratio per experiment.
